# Hosts and components: what can live where

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask hosts` from the declarations; do not edit. -->

A **host** is a place egui-pop draws content in (a docked panel, a
floating palette, a dialog). A **component** is something drawn there
(the image viewport, the tree, the terminal). Each cell answers: can
this component be mounted in this host, and if not, why not?

This page is generated from the mount contract
([ADR 0013](adr/0013-mount-contract.md)): each component declares what it
needs (`Mountable`), each host what it offers (`HostOffer`), and each
cell is the verdict of `egui_pop::model::mount::check` on the pair.
`cargo xtask hosts` writes it, and a test fails when the committed page
is stale. In an application, `AppHandle::where_can` gives the same
verdicts and the debug bridge's `mounts` collector shows them to agents.

## How to read a cell

| Cell | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `yes` | fits | Nothing in the way; mounted by the mount tests. |
| `if c…` | fits under conditions | Fits, under every condition named (see [Conditions](#conditions)). |
| `D…` | does not fit, by design | It would break a named rule on purpose; the rule says what to do instead. |
| `E…` | does not fit, egui-pop limit | egui-pop does not do it yet; an estimated cost is given. |
| `U…` | does not fit, upstream limit | egui, eframe or another dependency cannot do it; linked to [upstream.md](upstream.md). |
| `…*` | not tried | Fits by the declarations, but no headless test can mount it there (see [Notes](#notes)): a gap, not a refusal. |

"Impossible" is only ever a `D` or a `U`. An `E` is work not done yet.

## The hosts

| Column | Host | Where in the code | What it offers |
|---|---|---|---|
| **P** | Docked panel | `Ctx::panel`, `PanelSpec`, `workbench` | A whole rect; resized by the user; shared focus; persistent; main window; the keymap reaches it; keeps its place; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`, a focus scope, a fault boundary; wide gamut; may hide its content. |
| **F** | Floating palette | `palettes` | A bounded width, the content's height; resized by the user; the keyboard once clicked into; persistent; main window; the keymap reaches it; keeps its place, size; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`, a focus scope, a fault boundary; sRGB; may hide its content. |
| **W** | Auxiliary window | `workbench::windows`, `show_viewport_immediate` | A whole rect; resized by the user; shared focus; persistent; an auxiliary window; the keymap reaches it; keeps its place, size; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`, a focus scope, a fault boundary; sRGB; system cursors only. |
| **D** | Dialog (four kinds) | `dialogs: Confirm`, `Form`, `Choose`, `Info` | A bounded width, the content's height; not resizable; modal: the whole keyboard; owns Enter, Escape; closed by an answer, Escape; transient; main window; the keymap reaches it; keeps its place; gives a `Ui`; descriptor fields only; sRGB. |
| **C** | Custom dialog | `dialogs: Dialog::Custom`, `Dialogs::open_custom` | A size of its own declaration; not resizable; modal: the whole keyboard; owns Enter, Escape (given to a content claiming them); closed by an answer, Escape; transient; main window; the keymap reaches it; keeps its place; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`, a focus scope, a fault boundary; sRGB. |
| **M** | Raw modal | `overlay::show with Kind::Modal` | A bounded width, the content's height; not resizable; modal: the whole keyboard; owns Escape; closed by Escape; transient; main window; the keymap reaches it; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`, a fault boundary; sRGB. |
| **O** | Popover | `overlay::show with Kind::Popover`, `egui::Popup` | A bounded width, the content's height; not resizable; shared focus; owns Escape; closed by Escape, a click outside; transient; main window; the keymap reaches it; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`; sRGB. |
| **L** | Line zone | `zones: TOP_BAR`, `TITLE_BAR`, `ACTIVITY_BAR` | One row; not resizable; shared focus; persistent; main window; the keymap reaches it; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`, a focus scope, a fault boundary; sRGB. |
| **S** | Status bar | `zones: STATUS_BAR`, `strips` | One row; not resizable; shared focus; persistent; main window; the keymap reaches it; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`, a focus scope, a fault boundary; sRGB. |
| **T** | Settings page | `Ctx::settings_page`, `SettingsPage` | A bounded width, the content's height; not resizable; modal: the whole keyboard; owns Escape; closed by Escape; transient; main window; the keymap reaches it; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`, a focus scope, a fault boundary; sRGB; may hide its content. |
| **V** | Viewport overlay | `egui_pop_viewport::overlay` | **no `Ui`: data only**; no keyboard; persistent; its panel's window; sRGB. |
| **G** | Gallery story | `Ctx::story`, `Story` | A whole rect; resized by the user; shared focus; persistent; main window; the keymap reaches it; gives a `Ui`, an `AppHandle`, a focus scope, a fault boundary; wide gamut. |

Hosts that take **no component at all**, by design, and so have no column:

- **Toast** (`toasts`): text, a level, actions and a job's progress;
  data only. A component goes in the jobs centre or a panel the toast's
  action opens.
- **Menus and the command palette**: items, not content.
- **A palette outside the main window** (a native utility window): not
  built, and blocked upstream, U3.

| Row | Crate | What it needs |
|---|---|---|
| Image viewport | `egui-pop-viewport` | Keys while hovered, claims Space, Escape; drags, wheel, bitmap cursors; workers, drained when drawn, kept under a modal; wide gamut wanted; fills; role `image`. |
| Navigator | `egui-pop-viewport` | Keys when focused; drags, wheel; at least 120 by 80, at most 320 by 214, aspect 1.5; role `image`. |

| Sliders | `egui-pop-core` | Keys when focused, claims Enter, Escape; drags; at least 120 by 20; a descriptor field; role `slider`. |

## Rules

Each rule looks at one need against one offer. The worst verdict wins,
and every condition is kept.

| Rule | Name | What it compares |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | size | The size needed (minimum, fills) against the room the host gives (a rect, a given size, the content's height, one row). |
| R2 | keyboard | The keyboard needed and the keys claimed against the host's focus policy and the keys it owns; bindings of the keymap against the host's keymap reach. |
| R3 | sessions and lifetime | A session (unsaved work, a running program) or popups of the component's own against a transient host and what dismisses it. |
| R4 | questions | A question to answer against a host that is not modal. |
| R5 | display | Wide gamut wanted or required, and bitmap cursors, against what the host's window can show. |
| R6 | instances | One state per application against a host that may show it beside another mount. |
| R7 | application | A component needing the application against a host giving none. |
| R8 | a Ui | Any component against a host that gives no `Ui`. |
| R9 | workers | Workers drained when the component is drawn against a host that can stop drawing it. |
| R10 | view state | A view-state key against a host that keeps no view values and is outside the projection. |
| R11 | dialog content | Free content against a dialog of the four kinds, which takes value-descriptor fields only. |

## Conditions

| Code | Condition |
|---|---|
| c1 | **Content-sized host.** The palette, the raw modal, the popover and the dialogs of the four kinds size themselves from their content: a component that fills the space it is given must be given an explicit size (`.size()`, a `ScrollArea` with a maximum height) or it grows to the window. A palette keeps its content's size until the user resizes it. |
| c2 | **No keymap in this window.** The host's window is not reached by the key dispatcher, so bindings of the keymap (global and surface ones: an editor's find and save, the terminal's clear, the library's commands) do not fire while it has the keyboard. Keys a widget reads itself (arrows, zoom keys, typing) work. No host of egui-pop has this condition since E3 closed; a host an application declares may. |
| c3 | **sRGB and system cursors.** Wide gamut and HDR fall back to sRGB in this host, with the reason reported (U2); bitmap tool cursors fall back to their system cursor (U1). |
| c4 | **The host takes its keys first.** The host owns keys the component claims: Escape closes a modal or a popover before any component sees it, Enter accepts a dialog (ADR 0007's Escape order). A component's own Escape (a graph's deselect, a terminal program's Escape) never arrives; Shift+Escape still leaves the terminal. |
| c5 | **Popups inside a transient host.** The component opens egui areas of its own (completion lists, context menus, drop-downs) outside egui-pop's overlay stack; whether a click in them counts as a click outside the host (which closes a popover) is not checked. |
| c6 | **One row.** A compact size given by the application: a slider at least 120 wide, a small thumbnail, a thin bar, within one row. |
| c7 | **One state per application.** The component draws a service's state: two mounts (a panel and a popover) show the same jobs or the same draft, not two independent instances. |
| c8 | **As a descriptor field only.** In a dialog of the four kinds, the component exists only as a `Form` field made from a value descriptor (a slider from a float or int), not as a free widget; a `Custom` dialog takes it as it is. |
| c9 | **Claims honoured by declaration.** The host owns Enter and Escape, and gives them to a content that claims them: when the content claims Enter, Ctrl+Enter accepts; Escape goes first to a content that claims it and has something to cancel (a drag), then cancels. |
| c10 | **A session per showing.** The host is transient: shown again, the component starts a new session (a new program, an empty draft) unless the application keeps its state; closing it asks first or loses the session. |
| c11 | **A queue while hidden.** The host can stop drawing its content (a tab behind another, a palette hidden by Tab or rolled up) while the component's workers keep delivering: their queue grows until it is drawn again (docs/threading.md, section 2.2). |
| c12 | **View state not kept.** The host keeps no view values and is outside the context stack's projection: the component's zoom, scroll or selection is not kept across places and restarts. |

## Reasons

### By design

| Code | Rule | Do instead |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | **Line hosts hold one row.** The top bar, the caption, the activity bar and the status bar hold indicators and small controls; nothing there takes the keyboard for long or needs more than a row. | An item in the line that opens a popover (the jobs centre's status item) or focuses a panel (`<panel>.focus`). |
| D2 | **Viewport overlays are data.** Overlays on the image are shapes and handles in image coordinates, drawn by the viewport, their edits handed back as signals; there is no `Ui` to put a component in. | A palette floating over the canvas (a navigator, a toolbox), or a heads-up host over the viewport (not built yet: decided for later). |
| D3 | **Popovers are transient.** A click outside or Escape closes them; an edit session (graph wiring, an editor with unsaved text, a running program, a theme draft) would end by accident (confirmed 2026-10-14). | A panel, a palette, or a dialog that asks before closing. |
| D4 | **Only a modal asks.** Palettes are never modal (decided 2026-10-13), nor are panels and popovers: a question that must be answered before going on goes in a modal. | A dialog. |
| D5 | **One dialog at a time.** Dialogs queue; a dialog does not open another over it. | Draw the second choice inline in the dialog (as a form's path field draws the in-app file picker). |
| D6 | **The four dialog kinds take descriptors.** `Confirm`, `Form`, `Choose` and `Info` are drawn from data: a form's fields come from value descriptors, and no kind takes free content. | A `Custom` dialog, which takes a body and keeps every dialog rule. |

D4 and D5 constrain how a component is used rather than where it fits:
no component of today asks a question of its own, and a dialog's body
draws a second choice inline.

### egui-pop limits

| Code | Limit | Estimated cost |
|---|---|---|
| E1 | **No free-content dialog (closed).** Closed by `Dialog::Custom` (ADR 0013): a dialog with a body of its own, keeping the dialog rules. | Done. |
| E2 | **Palettes are not resizable (closed).** Closed: a palette is resized by its right and bottom edges, between the `palette.min-*` and `palette.max-*` tokens, its size kept in the layout. | Done. |
| E3 | **No keymap in auxiliary windows (closed).** Closed: the key dispatcher runs in each auxiliary window's pass, in that window's context (its focus chain, `window` naming its panel). | Done. |
| E4 | **Overlays live in the main window (closed for dialogs).** Closed for dialogs: each window has its own overlay stack, a dialog opened from an auxiliary window is shown over it, and while it is open every other window is blocked. Menus, toasts and the command palette are still drawn in the main window. | Done for dialogs; for the other overlays, a block in the `WINDOW_OVERLAYS` zone drawing in its own window (not decided). |
| E5 | **No custom page in the settings window (closed).** Closed by settings pages (`Ctx::settings_page`): a page a plugin draws itself in the settings window, placed in its tree, searched, with its reset (column T). | Done. |

The overlays E4 leaves in the main window appear as hosts that do not
exist yet, not as refused cells.

### Upstream limits

| Code | Limit | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| U1 | **No custom cursor in immediate viewports.** eframe shows no custom cursor in an immediate viewport (nor on the web): bitmap cursors fall back to system cursors there. | [upstream.md](upstream.md#eframe-no-custom-cursor-on-the-web-or-in-immediate-viewports) |
| U2 | **Wide gamut in the main window only.** Wide gamut goes through the image's own Wayland surface, made from the main window's handles: eframe gives no surface colour space and winit no colour management, so other windows draw sRGB. | [upstream.md](upstream.md#wayland-no-colour-management-through-winit) |
| U3 | **No owner window for egui viewports.** A palette in a native utility window would float above every application. | [upstream.md](upstream.md#winit-and-egui-no-owner-window-for-a-viewport) |

U1 and U2 degrade a cell (condition c3) rather than refuse it: no
component of today requires wide gamut. One that did (a mastering view)
would be refused outside the main window with U2.

## Notes

- **Evidence.** `crates/egui-pop-gallery/tests/mounts.rs` mounts every component's gallery story
  in a mock host built from each offer that accepts it (the panel and
  the story by the gallery itself; the palette as an area of bounded
  width; the raw modal and the popover through the overlay stack; the
  custom dialog as a `Dialog::Custom`; the lines as one row), checks that
  nothing faults, that every interactive node has a name and that no
  diagnostic is raised, and checks that each refused mount is reported
  with its rule.
- **Workers.** Tile, thumbnail, tree and terminal sources run on the
  application's threads and keep running whatever the host, a modal
  included; their queues are drained when the component is drawn (c11).
- **Accessibility in an auxiliary window** is not tried: whether eframe
  gives an immediate viewport its own AccessKit tree has not been
  checked.
- **Tests across windows.** egui_kittest draws an immediate viewport
  inside the main one. The keys, dialogs and focus of auxiliary windows
  are tested with an immediate viewport renderer of the tests' own
  (`crates/egui-pop-api/tests/windows.rs`), each window's pass run with
  its own input, but no component is mounted in a real window there:
  the cells stay `*`.
- **Declarations can lie.** A component declared as reading keys when
  focused that reads one globally (the node graph's Space) shows a fit
  where it misbehaves; the mount tests are the guard.
